name: com.aidancmays.character-stats
description: Stats and resource pools for RPG characters: stat assets with inheritance, modifiers (flat, percent, multiply, override, scaled by another stat, conditional on gameplay tags), per-archetype profiles, and pools such as stamina, health and exhaustion with regeneration, regen delay, overdraw into another pool, overflow, reserved capacity and tags while full. Save snapshots and a debug panel included.

samples.description: Health, stamina and exhaustion pools where overspending stamina builds exhaustion that eats the stamina bar and then hurts, with buttons to try it.
